description: Lists the user's media library: folders, and files with id, name, kind, size and folder. `storage` says whether a file is 'linked' (still on their disk) or 'copied' (held by the browser); a linked file can need the user to re-grant access after a reload.

path.description: Folder to list. Omit for all.

token.description: The session token that connect returned.

name: list_media
title: List media
